# Reach Social — Blog

Operator notes on TikTok Shop from Reach Social (reachsocial.co), a Verified
TikTok Shop Partner for 8- and 9-figure eCommerce brands. $50M+ GMV generated.
Posts are written in the Reach Social company voice; client names anonymized.

## Posts

- [How TikTok Shop Affiliate Programs Actually Work (and How to Build One That Converts)](https://reachsocial.co/blog/tiktok-shop-affiliate-program/): How TikTok Shop affiliate programs work — recruiting, sampling, and commission tiers — and the four moves (recruit on data, treat sampling like inventory, build a reactivation cadence, give the roster a home) that turn a stalled program into the channel driving most of a shop's GMV. Published 2026-07-21.
- [What Is a Social Commerce Agency? A Buyer's Checklist for TikTok Shop](https://reachsocial.co/blog/social-commerce-agency/): What a social commerce agency actually does, and the four things to check before signing — a real Creator Engine, affiliate ops as a system, GMV Max fluency, and proof that holds under pressure. Published 2026-07-14.
- [TikTok Shop Strategy for 8- and 9-Figure Brands: Treat It as Retail, Not Social](https://reachsocial.co/blog/tiktok-shop-strategy-retail-not-social/): Why the winning TikTok Shop operating model is retail, not social — the Creator Engine, three revenue lanes (affiliates, shop ops, GMV Max), SKM tier, and a 90-day plan. Published 2026-07-08.
